en: A black and white (sepia-toned) postcard image showing a large wooden building with many windows, surrounded by trees. People, including women in historical dress and a child with a bicycle, are visible in the foreground, suggesting a park or estate-like setting. The text on the image references 'Gustafsberg' and the 'Uddevalla Museum.' There is also a timestamp of 'Feb. 1903.'
